verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200. First-party docs describe per-product llms.txt indexes, a whole-corpus llms-full.txt, /index.md Markdown mirrors of every page, `Accept: text/markdown` content negotiation, and a dedicated agent-setup hub with per-agent guides. A keyless docs MCP server is also live-verified, so an agent can consume the docs directly. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of llms-full.txt and the Markdown content negotiation, which are documented but not probed.
